subtopics.subtopic_description: In this subtopic, students will learn how to set up their development environment for Python and Django. This includes installing necessary software like Python, Django, and a code editor. Understanding the environment setup is crucial for writing and running Python and Django code effectively. Students will also learn how to use virtual environments to manage dependencies. Setting up the environment is a foundational step that ensures a smooth development process.
subtopics.co: Create a simple web application using Django framework

subtopics.subtopic_title: Creating a Django Project and Understanding Models
subtopics.subtopic_description: Students will create their first Django project and dive into the core component of Django: models. They will learn how to define models, which represent the data structures in a Django application. This subtopic covers creating models, defining model fields, and understanding relationships between models. Understanding models is essential as they form the backbone of any Django application, allowing developers to store and retrieve data efficiently.
subtopics.co: Create a simple web application using Django framework

subtopics.subtopic_description: Explore advanced form handling techniques including custom form validation, form field customization, and form rendering. Understand how to integrate forms with Django’s authentication system and use form signals for form lifecycle management. Learn best practices for form error handling and form submission.
subtopics.co: Create a simple web application using Django framework

subtopics.subtopic_title: Secure Authentication and Authorization in Django
subtopics.subtopic_description: Delve into Django’s authentication system, including user management, password hashing, and session management. Learn about different authentication backends and how to extend the default authentication system. Understand the importance of secure authentication and authorization practices in web applications, including session management, CSRF protection, and role-based access control. Explore advanced topics such as password reset functionality and multi-factor authentication.
subtopics.co: Create a simple web application using Django framework
